problems.source_text: One drawback to this type of computer-based instruction is that some learners may lose motivation when using a repetitive format. ... Another approach is to gamify the learning by adding expanded feedback (e.g., total score points) and communication with other people
problems.reason: The source names loss of motivation from repetitive drill as the risk and offers gamification as a fix, so calling 'gamification burnout' the risk of FaCT/MoFaCTS turns the source's point around.

problems.location: Concept 2: Cognitive Architecture and Strategies for Knowledge Retention / block 3
problems.lesson_text: Blocked study emphasizes within-category similarities but impairs category discrimination (Carvalho & Goldstone, 2014a).

problems.location: Concept 5: Pedagogical Affordances and Systemic Alignment of Learning Technologies / block 2

problems.reason: The lesson states as fact that these games harness intrinsic motivation, while the source says this claim has very little evidence behind it.
